description: Crazy destiny and retrieval...I've seen this deck win 90 percent of the time...
strategy:
This deck has insanely high destiny with insanely high retrieve…

Average Destiny- 3.45

Without Locations/I Did It- 3.91

Podrace, Retrieve, Win

Deploy Jedi, use combat cards… If they have Ability ^3 (V) on table use cards that are useless to you as combat cards…If they don’t stack 7’s, get out Leia with her gun and you can use Rebel Artillery although it is not important… Once your done pod racing get out Masatair, you can drain for 2 a turn and retrieve 2 a turn (one with Luke and one with I Did It!)… Your drains should be relatively large if they don’t come after you… Flash of Insight helps you retrieve (you know when one of your 8 7’s is on top… You can pull Naked Threepio and Artoo with Seeking an Audience… You can retrieve about 4-8 force each turn and do about 2-4 damage each turn making it a very long game… Usually you won’t have a lost pile at the end of the game giving you a 25-35+ win which may help you a lot in the long run…

Flash Of Insight - helps your retrieval and helps you cycle stuff through your deck…

Escape Pod - makes it so your Jedi less vulnerable to be placed out play.
